user.title: KI MSH
user.description: The cards are loaded by the integration, and the dashboard is created automatically with the custom:ki-dashboard strategy. Everything can be changed later under Configure.

rom.title: Rooms
rom.description: Which rooms get popups and room counters. The room counters are the same ones KI Rom creates (sensor.ROOM_lys … sensor.ROOM_oversikt). Automatic = only when KI Rom is not installed.

kilder.title: Data sources
kilder.description: KI MSH finds most things itself (KI Rom, KI Energi, HA Energy, price sensors). Choose here only where automatic detection is wrong or missing.

bubble_mangler.title: Bubble Card is missing
bubble_mangler.description: The KI MSH popups need Bubble Card. Install it from HACS, or choose «Load from jsDelivr» under KI MSH → Configure → Cards.

frontend_mangler.title: ki-msh.js is missing from the integration
frontend_mangler.description: The file custom_components/ki_msh/frontend/ki-msh.js does not exist. Reinstall KI MSH from HACS.
